title: bidens jacksonii
intro: Bidens jacksonii, commonly known as Bidens, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family, characterized by its small white or pink flowers and broad, toothed leaves. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, cold, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Bidens jacksonii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can help in soothing sore throats, reducing swelling, and fighting infections. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties.
